title: Yvie Oddly wins Season 11
summary: In the Grand Finale (US-S11-E14), Yvie Oddly was crowned America's Next Drag Superstar after a Lip Sync Smackdown for the Crown. Brooke Lynn Hytes finished as runner-up; A'keria C. Davenport and Silky Nutmeg Ganache placed third. The Season 11 cash prize was $100,000. Nina West was announced as Miss Congeniality.

title: Miss Vanjie returns for Season 11
summary: After an iconic first-out exit on Season 10, Vanessa Vanjie Mateo returned by popular demand for Season 11 — the first queen through the workroom doors on Whatcha Unpackin? (US-S11-E01). She competed through Queens Everywhere (US-S11-E12), placing fifth.

title: Brooke Lynn and Yvie's double shantay
summary: On Snatch Game at Sea (US-S11-E08), Brooke Lynn Hytes and Yvie Oddly lip-synced to Demi Lovato's "Sorry Not Sorry." Both were declared winners and neither was eliminated — a double shantay that kept the Top 8 intact.
